title: The Old Workings
text: Drill long enough in the crust and you find them: timbered galleries hundreds of meters below the deepest mine on record. The props are squared by axe and set cap-and-post, in a style a century out of date. The rails are hand-forged, the crates nailed, never screwed. Every crate carries the same stencil, a company name that appears in no registry, tax roll or newspaper, and a depot in a town that was never built. Pasted inside one crate lid is a printed circular from 1818 inviting a hundred companions on an expedition to the polar openings. The signature has been scraped off with a knife.
teaser: Somebody mined down here before anyone could have.
